title: Two Wheeler Service at Home in Bangalore | Mechanix Pro
desc: Two wheeler doorstep service in Bangalore (Bengaluru). Expert mechanics come to your home or office, quote on WhatsApp first, servicing in as fast as 2 hours.
h1: Two wheeler service at home in Bangalore.
lead: A Mechanix Pro mechanic comes to your door for your bike or scooter. You get a quote on WhatsApp first, and work starts only after you say yes. Servicing in as fast as 2 hours.
tiles: Expert 2-wheeler service
Basic, Standard and Full service by Mechanix Pro-certified mechanics, with a clear checklist of 15, 24 or 28 points.
Doorstep, not a garage queue
We service at your home, office parking or society. No pickup, no losing half a day at a workshop.
Quote first, pay after you say yes
Your price comes on WhatsApp before any work. Parts and extra work are charged only after you approve.
Servicing in as fast as 2 hours
Once the mechanic arrives, a basic service can be done in about two hours, and pickup and drop is free in our serviceable area. Bigger jobs take longer, and we tell you before we start.
Digital service records
Every job has a booking reference and a GST invoice, and your bike's history is kept against its registration number.
30-day service warranty
If the same work fails within 30 days, we redo it free. Parts carry the maker's or supplier's limited warranty.
steps: Build your service, or message us on WhatsApp with your bike and area.
Our expert sends your quote. You approve it and pick a slot.
The mechanic arrives, services your bike at your door and shows you what was done.
You get your GST invoice, and your service record is saved.
faq: Do you do two wheeler service at home in Bangalore?
Yes. Our mechanics come to your home, office or society parking across Bangalore (Bengaluru), for bikes and scooters, petrol and electric.
How fast can a service be done?
A basic service can be done in as fast as 2 hours once the mechanic arrives. The time depends on the package and on what the mechanic finds, and we tell you before any extra work starts.
What does it cost?

Basic from {{text:basic}}, Standard from {{text:general}}, Full from {{text:full}} for bikes up to 149cc, GST included. Bikes of 150 to 250cc and 251 to 500cc have their own prices. Your exact quote comes on WhatsApp first.
Which bikes do you service?
Scooters, commuter motorcycles, Royal Enfields, performance bikes and electric scooters. Not sure about yours? Message us the model and we confirm.

title: Scooty Repair at Home in Bangalore | Mechanix Pro
desc: Scooty and scooter repair at your home in Bangalore. Problem check by an expert mechanic, quote first on WhatsApp, work after you approve. Open 24/7.
h1: Scooty repair at home in Bangalore.
lead: Activa, Jupiter, Access, Dio or an electric scooter: tell us what is wrong and a mechanic comes to your door, finds the cause and quotes the fix before any work starts.
tiles: Hard to start
Often a weak battery, a worn spark plug or a dirty air filter. We test and tell you which.
Low pickup or mileage
Often a clogged air filter, old oil or a worn belt. A service usually brings it back.
Brakes weak or noisy
Often worn shoes or pads. We check them and show you before replacing anything.
Puncture or worn tyre
We come to you for a puncture, and check the tread and pressure on the spot.
Battery or self-start
A battery health test shows if your scooty will start tomorrow.
Strange noise or vibration
Chain, belt, suspension or bearings. We find the cause first and quote the fix.
steps: Tell us the problem on WhatsApp, or tick it in our free symptom guide.
Book a problem check. A mechanic comes at your slot.
He finds the cause and sends a quote. Nothing extra starts until you say yes.
You get your invoice, and the repair is saved in your service record.
faq: Can you repair my scooty at home?

Most scooty problems can be checked and many fixed at your door: starting, brakes, battery, tyres, belts and servicing. If a repair needs a workshop, we tell you before anything is moved, and the bike leaves only with your one-time code.
How much is a problem check?
A repair or problem check starts from {{text:repair}}, GST included. The repair itself is quoted after the check.
My scooty broke down on the road. What now?
Use our roadside help: share your location on WhatsApp and we send the nearest mechanic. Roadside visits start from {{text:sos}}.
Do you repair electric scooters too?
Yes, we check electric scooters for range, charging, brakes, tyres, lights and display problems.

Roadside help for both

Electric bikes use the problem check, from {{text:repair}}, GST included.
Is petrol bike service different?
